content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have solid experience with [product_name] modules, using them in standalone configurations. I often program in Delphi, and I believe it's possible to read and write values to a [product_name] PLC. However, I've tried many approaches, including libraries like libnodave and modbusTCP, but haven't had success. Any practical advice to get started would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!

Hi, I don't have deep experience with [product_name], especially recent versions, but I know MB TCP has been supported in some versions. Since it's similar to an S7 controller, I would expect S7 protocol as standard, possibly TCP/UDP as OUC. It might be helpful to check with [user_name] in the [product_name] Conference or review the documentation for your specific [article_no] family. Admins may also relocate this topic for further visibility.
I’m sorry, I don’t have experience with Delphi.
Hi, On another note, there are numerous Youtube tutorials available. You can explore options focusing on Delphi and S7 controllers.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to enable communication between Delphi applications and a [product_name] PLC, seeking to read and write values but unable to achieve this using existing libraries like libnodave or modbusTCP.
